//: PROPOSED, and currently unused: CI has no AWS identity at all, which is the stronger position.
//why: This document exists so that if somebody is ever asked to give CI credentials, there is a written answer to 'what would it need' that is smaller than 'an admin key'. The untrusted workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) references no repository secret and asserts that it does not.

Statement.//: CI runs code from pull requests, including forks. Any credential reachable from that pipeline is a credential a contributor can exfiltrate by adding a step. The only safe amount is none, and every service CI needs is a throwaway container inside the job.
